part: Feature 6 — context initialization benchmark and allocation evidence
sourceCommit: feature-6 tree; replaced with the audited commit at closeout

budgets.comparisonRule: Compare the median of the identical Criterion benchmark on the matching runner class only. A release candidate fails when its median is more than 1.10 x the recorded median or above the documented 100 ms / 64 MiB budget. Absolute timings are never compared across CPUs, operating systems, or Rust versions.

ceria_10x10x10.model: msl-v1 ceria primary model; no pair or cluster tables

populated_clone_10x10x10.fixture: step-13-populated model cloned onto a hand-built 10x10x10 InitialLattice in the benchmark

allocationEvidence.countingAllocator: tests/allocation.rs (own test binary, global allocator wrapper)
allocationEvidence.note: The build allocates the planned arrays once plus short-lived construction temporaries (the plan entries, the link/cluster/pool builders, and the tracker mapping); the per-array capacity equals or exceeds the plan and the hot accessors and pool set_selectable helpers allocate nothing after construction.

memoryNote: The 10x10x10 ceria fixture is table-free; the populated clone carries the real pair/cluster tables and is the pair/cluster-scale measurement. Both are far below the 64 MiB budget.
evidenceStatus: Local-container evidence recorded; Step 29 owns the same-class automated regression job. The runner class is declared so the 10% rule can be applied only within it.
